Boasting a host of impressive upgrades, this Avalanche LTZ stands out from the crowd. Key features include:
- Power-retractable assist steps with chrome accent stripes
- Integrated trailer brake controller for effortless towing
- Heavy-duty trailering package with upgraded cooling systems
- Sun, entertainment, and destinations package with navigation, sunroof, and rear-seat DVD entertainment

Beneath the bold, commanding exterior lies a powerful Vortec 5.3L V8 engine mated to a smooth-shifting 6-speed automatic transmission. With 4-wheel drive and a maximum towing capacity of over 8,000 pounds, this Avalanche is ready to take on any adventure, from hauling the family camper to conquering challenging off-road terrain.

Inside, the spacious cabin exudes refinement, with custom perforated leather-appointed seating, heated and cooled front seats, and a premium Bose audio system. The intuitive infotainment system with navigation keeps you connected and informed, while the rear-seat entertainment system ensures your passengers enjoy the ride.

Safety and convenience are also top priorities, with features like forward collision alert, lane departure warning, and a rear-view camera to help you navigate with confidence. The Avalanche's Autoride suspension package provides a smooth, controlled ride, while the integrated trailer brake controller and heavy-duty trailering package make towing a breeze.

Whether you're seeking a capable family hauler, a versatile work vehicle, or a luxurious weekend getaway companion, this 2013 Chevrolet Avalanche 1500 LTZ is the perfect choice. Experience the perfect blend of power, technology, and refinement visit our showroom today to take this remarkable SUV for a test drive.

Family Owned and Operated since 1994

2020 Dodge Journey SE Granite Crystal Metallic Clearcoat FWD 2.4L I4 DOHC 16V Dual VVT
Recent Arrival! CARFAX One Owner.

Rear parking sensors and a backup camera help with everyday parking.

17-inch wheels with all-season touring tires.
Rear heater, rear window defogger, and rear washer.
Three 12-volt power outlets and underfloor cargo storage.
Front-wheel drive with 4-wheel disc brakes, ABS, and electronic stability control.
Trailer sway control is included.
2.4L 4-cylinder gas engine with automatic transmission.
Estimated fuel economy of 19 city, 25 highway, and 21 combined mpg.
